title.zh: 创建：取款请求 + owner 凭证

role.zh: owned cell 相对 owner cell 的序号偏移 i32 LE
role.en: index offset of the owned cell relative to the owner i32 LE

cons.zh: 恰好指向一个 owned cell
cons.en: points to exactly one owned cell

cond.zh: lock = 本脚本的 cell 必须是 DAO 取款请求
cond.en: a cell locked by this script must be a DAO withdrawal request

cond.zh: 不能同时 lock = type = 本脚本
cond.en: not both lock and type = this script

cond.zh: 输出中每个 owned 恰有一个 owner 指向它（序号 + distance）
cond.en: in outputs each owned has exactly one owner pointing to it (index + distance)

title.zh: 领取：用 owner 解锁取款请求
title.en: Claim: unlock the withdrawal request with the owner

inputs.label: owned
inputs.body: Cell{ lock: OWNED_OWNER, type: NERVOS_DAO }  @ OutPoint(tx, i)

body.zh: Cell{ lock: user（签名）, type: OWNED_OWNER, data: distance }  @ OutPoint(tx, j)
body.en: Cell{ lock: user (signs), type: OWNED_OWNER, data: distance }  @ OutPoint(tx, j)

body.zh: 任意（DAO 规则另行检查）

cond.zh: 输入中按 OutPoint：owned 的 (tx, i) = owner 的 (tx, j + distance)，一一对应
cond.en: in inputs by OutPoint: owned (tx, i) = owner (tx, j + distance), one to one

notes.zh: 错误码：1–4 系统 · 5 NotEmptyArgs · 6 NotWithdrawalRequest · 7 ScriptMisuse · 8 Mismatch
notes.en: Error codes: 1–4 syscall · 5 NotEmptyArgs · 6 NotWithdrawalRequest · 7 ScriptMisuse · 8 Mismatch

notes.zh: 作用：让任何人都能代用户发起 DAO 取款，而只有 owner cell 的持有者能领取
notes.en: Purpose: anyone can create a DAO withdrawal for a user, but only the owner-cell holder can claim it
